Reference 1 is the APPROVED HERO sheet: preserve the same tousled dark chestnut hair silhouette, warm skin, rounded large head, dark brown outlines and warm upper-left highlights. Reference 2 is his portrait. Create THIS SAME BOY at FIVE YEARS OLD, small round child, cream knee-length nightshirt, bare small feet, brass key on a dark cord visible over back of nightshirt (as in wall plate), holding a short candle in his RIGHT hand. Back three-quarter view, facing wall away from camera, slightly toward right. No cape or adult clothes. True transparent background. No ground, shadows, glow haze, text or grid.
STRICT FOUR columns FOUR rows of equal SQUARE cells. 16 cells. Same child and exact same body/head dimensions, feet position and baseline throughout. Generous padding including above raised candle. Row 3: TWO high candle holding variations then repeat them. Row 4: TWO head-turn stages toward the door to HIS RIGHT, keeping candle high and body facing away, then repeat them. Flame visible attached to wick, no external lighting. Big head, chunky 1-2 pixel final outline, precise readable pixel clusters matching hero at 128x128 final frame. Child proportions, not a different character.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production cozy pixel RPG sprite sheet matching approved game hero (reference 1) in pixel density, dark brown 1-2 pixel outlines, big head small feet and warm upper-left light. Reference 2 is HOBB's portrait for identity and clothes ONLY. AGE HER to visibly 58-62, not a young girl: lined eyes, heavy cheeks, deep smile lines, greying brown hair in bun with cream cloth tie, stout round body, strong thick forearms. Cream blouse with sleeves rolled, russet brown apron with scorch patches, belt ladle, brown skirt and sturdy shoes. She faces us slightly side-on toward screen left, in a doorway but NO doorway/background drawn.
STRICT FOUR columns TWO rows, 8 equally sized SQUARE cells, true transparency, no text, grid, ground or shadow. Row 1 FOUR subtle standing breathing phases. Row 2 THREE successive small firm 'bed, now' head tilt poses, right hand on hip, elbow out, warm bossy expression; fourth repeats last. Same old woman and same head and body size throughout; no turning around. Keep feet baseline and feet positions identical across every cell, whole body visible with generous padding. Chunky readable pixel clusters, not smooth illustration, no teal, no white fringe. Make her age unmistakable.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW sprite sheet, FOUR columns TWO rows, eight equal square cells, transparent background. Cozy anime PIXEL RPG, chunky pixel clusters and dark brown tinted outlines like reference 1 approved hero sheet. Full bodies, big heads small feet. HOBB: a stout elderly cook, SIXTY-FIVE YEARS OLD, unmistakably GRANDMOTHER AGE. Grey streaked brown hair in bun with cream kerchief, sagging jowls, heavy eyelids, crow's feet, forehead wrinkles, long nose, thin smiling lips with CLOSED MOUTH, small tired kindly eyes. NO youthful wide anime eyes, NO round baby face, NO open laughing mouth. Strong thick arms, rolled cream sleeves, scorched russet work apron, brass ladle at belt, dark skirt, brown shoes. Elderly face like an old village grandmother. Reference 2 supplies apron/hair identity ONLY; make face much older than that portrait. Row 1 FOUR standing subtle breathing phases facing three quarters screen-left. Row 2 THREE firm small head tilts saying bed now with hand on hip, fourth repeats last. Same body dimensions and baseline everywhere. Warm upper-left highlights, brown violet shadows, NO ground shadows, NO text, grid or halo, no teal. Plenty of transparent margin.

Use case: stylized-concept. A mysterious slender person in a LONG GREY HOODED COAT, seen ONLY FROM BEHIND, walking away from camera. No face ever, no hair, no insignia or teal. Grey violet shadows, dull grey cloth. STRICT SIX columns TWO rows, 12 equal square cells, generous padding, full body in each, genuine TRANSPARENT background, no ground, shadow, words or grid. Row 1 SIX DISTINCT successive walk phases forming one full seamless cycle: left boot forward right back, left weight down right lift, feet passing right swinging forward, right boot forward left back, right weight down left lift, feet passing left swinging forward. Opposing arm swings and coat hem alternating left/right, not six static identical poses. Row 2 six copies of ONE standing neutral back pose. Constant body and hood dimensions, same baseline and center every cell. Camera fixed, character never rotates. Pixel-art not smooth painted illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Cozy pixel RPG sprite sheet matching reference approved hero in warm brown tinted outlines and chunky pixel clusters. STRICT TWO columns ONE row, TWO equal SQUARE cells, true transparent background, no text, ground, cast shadow or grid. Each cell the SAME oval wicker basket, viewed from a little above at 35 degrees, with sleeping newborn baby nestled under a cream wool blanket, tiny warm skin face peeking out, a clearly visible BRASS KEY lying ON the blanket across its center. Woven honey-brown wicker rim, two small handles, stable basket shape. Frame 1 blanket resting low, frame 2 tiny rise of blanket over baby's chest during breathing. Basket and key stay fixed, no other motion. Whole basket in each cell, generous transparent margins. Upper-left warm highlight, brown violet shadows, no glow or teal. Target sprite is 128-square final, readable simple shapes, not photorealistic or a painted landscape.
